Join a state government transformation program and play a critical role in delivering complex data migration outcomes. Our client is a well-established State Government organisation undertaking a significant technology and business transformation program. The project involves modernising critical platforms and migrating large volumes of business data across enterprise environments.

About the Role

As the Senior Data Migration Specialist / Engineer, you will be responsible for analysing source and target data, designing and validating migration approaches, executing migration activities, and ensuring the quality and integrity of migrated data. You will work across business and technical teams, collaborating with stakeholders, architects, developers, vendors, and testers to deliver successful migration outcomes.

Data Analysis & Investigation

  • Analyse source and target datasets using SQL.
  • Investigate anomalies, data quality issues, and complex data relationships.

Data Mapping & Transformation

  • Translate business requirements into practical migration solutions.
Migration Execution

  • Support migration load development and execution.
  • Perform test migrations and assess outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot migration failures and implement corrective actions.
Validation & Reconciliation

  • Develop SQL-based validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Investigate discrepancies between source and target data.
  • Produce evidence confirming successful migration outcomes.
Testing, Cutover & Support

  • Support migration testing cycles and dress rehearsals.
  • Participate in cutover planning and execution.
  • Conduct post-migration validation and reconciliation activities.

  • Advanced SQL expertise, including creating and managing staging tables within SQL Server.
  • Strong experience with Azure, Azure Blob Storage, AWS S3, SQL databases, or similar data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering complex data migration and transformation projects.

  • Strong understanding of relational databases and complex data structures.
  • Experience with APIs, integrations, and data transformation solutions.
  • Excellent data quality, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, and access management.
  • Ability to operate across both technical implementation and business analysis functions.

  • Experience developing repeatable and automated migration processes.
